description: This file is a Java test setup class for the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement' package. It provides utility methods to create actors, configure mocks, and generate test data for testing enforcement components within the Ditto project. It includes static initializations for configurations, methods for actor creation, and nested classes for actor building and dummy publishers.

classes.name: TestSetup
classes.description: Utility class providing test setup methods for enforcement actor creation, configuration, and dummy publishers.

classes.name: EnforcerActorBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing enforcement actors with various configurations for testing purposes.

classes.name: DummyLiveSignalPub
classes.description: Mock implementation of the LiveSignalPub interface for testing signal publication without real network communication.

methods.description: Factory methods to create new enforcement actor instances with different configurations.

methods.description: Setter for optional PreEnforcer component in EnforcerActorBuilder.

methods.name: setConciergeForwarder
methods.description: Setter for optional concierge forwarder actor in EnforcerActorBuilder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a configured enforcement actor based on the builder's settings.

methods.description: Generates a unique name string for actor or component identifiers.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Generates a DittoHeaders object with specific schema version and authorization context for testing.
